scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: vp i && if [ -n "$T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH" ]; then ln -sf "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" .env && ln -sf "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/infra/relay/.env" infra/relay/.env; else echo "Not in a worktree - skipping .env symlinks"; fi && node apps/web/scripts/warm-dep-cache.ts
